PLURALIST_PARLIAMENTARY.name: Pluralist Parliamentary Republic
PLURALIST_PARLIAMENTARY.headline: Scientific surge & peacetime prosperity • Rapid wartime fatigue
PLURALIST_PARLIAMENTARY.description: An open society relying on research institutes and free markets boasting high scientific breakthroughs, but vulnerable to civil unrest during prolonged wars.
pros: 20% discount on all scientific and R&D expenditures
cons: 50% sharper stability loss during active warfare

IDEOLOGICAL_REGIME.name: Ideological Revolutionary Regime
IDEOLOGICAL_REGIME.headline: Low-cost military & high resilience in war • Scientific stagnation
IDEOLOGICAL_REGIME.description: A doctrinally mobilized society making armed forces highly cost-effective and resistant to attrition, but penalized in technical R&D due to scientific isolation.
pros: 20% reduction in monthly armed forces payroll and maintenance
50% greater resilience against war-weariness stability loss
cons: 20% increase in research and scientific breakthrough costs
30% slower natural stability recovery during peacetime

TECHNOCRATIC_ONE_PARTY.name: Technocratic Industrial State
TECHNOCRATIC_ONE_PARTY.headline: Inexpensive production & rapid expansion • Costly hardware upkeep
TECHNOCRATIC_ONE_PARTY.description: Centralized engineering discipline lowering the cost of factory construction and equipment assembly, but demanding higher maintenance for complex machinery.
pros: 20% discount on domestic factory construction and machinery
15% discount on industrial production line research
cons: 20% higher maintenance cost for advanced deployed weapon systems
25% greater stability sensitivity to national debt and fiscal crises

HEREDITARY_MONARCHY.name: Hereditary Traditional Monarchy
HEREDITARY_MONARCHY.headline: Steadfast political stability • Costly procurement rituals
HEREDITARY_MONARCHY.description: Dynastic legitimacy solidifying domestic security and loyalist armed forces, accompanied by ceremonial manufacturing friction and conservative R&D pacing.
pros: 40% higher resistance against political instability drops
10% lower military maintenance expenditure in peacetime
cons: 20% higher acquisition costs for cutting-edge modern equipment
15% increased expenditure for adopting new technologies

CENTRALIZED_PRESIDENTIAL.name: Centralized Presidential Republic
CENTRALIZED_PRESIDENTIAL.headline: Agile command through executive decrees • Symmetric balance
CENTRALIZED_PRESIDENTIAL.description: A unified executive authority accelerating strategic defense mobilization while maintaining a balanced profile across all civil and military spheres.
pros: 10% discount on rapid unit procurement and logistics
10% increased resistance against wartime stability weariness
cons: 10% higher administrative expenditure for armed forces bureaucracy
10% slower natural recovery of peacetime domestic stability
